facts.fact: 纽约住宿：Times Square 旁 Oriental Hotel，她订了两间连通房。
facts.anchor: I got us conjoining rooms because it was the cheapest option.

facts.fact: Maggie 短信预告：Mabel 得知她来纽约、想要见面（她本想避开）。
facts.anchor: she found out you were coming to visit and wants to see you.

facts.fact: Mabel 对她有半个母亲的恩义——没有慈母长大的她被这位前婆婆接纳过。
Sean 撞进来大声问晚饭，被电话那头的 Mabel 听个正着。
facts.anchor: Sean asks loudly, no doubt trying to be funny.

facts.fact: 她原打算在 Le Pigeon 说出「我还想要他」——被 Mabel 到场打断。
facts.anchor: all I want to do is watch his reaction when I tell him that I still want him.

facts.fact: Sean 的初见记忆：深粉连衣裙、芭蕾平底鞋、树荫下读《傲慢与偏见》的少女。
facts.anchor: You were reading Pride and Prejudice and sitting under this tree at the front of the school.

facts.fact: 餐桌上两人对 Mabel 只说「高中老友重逢」——她心里清楚这不全是实话。
facts.anchor: When I moved away, we lost contact. Then we ran into each other and we became friends again. It was like time never passed.

facts.fact: Mabel 金句：不去改变的，就是你在选择的——结局由你决定，别让恐惧拦你。
facts.anchor: You get to decide how this ends.
